newsitem.title: MEXICO: Eight die in Mexican helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Eight die in Mexican helicopter crash.

text.p: A Mexican federal police helicopter crashed and burst into flames on Friday, killing all eight passengers on board, the government said.
The accident at 10:32 a.m. (1532 GMT) may have been caused by a fireworks rocket fired at a local fair, a radio report said.
The crash took place in the district of Jiutepec in the central state of Morelos, the federal Ministry of Communications and Transport said in a statement.
The accident killed the pilot and co-pilot as well as the federal highway police commander for the region.
Also killed were the president of the Morelos state Investment Commission, his secretary and three cameramen from a private film production company.
